### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **HCI with BCS-tradition design / user-centered focus**.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure ACM SIGCHI-style work may be redirected.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure ACM SIGCHI-style work
- AI use without disclosure per OUP policy

### Soft Tax

Low for UK HCI tradition.

### Best Suited For

- User-centered design research
- Accessibility HCI
- Design-research HCI
- BCS-community UK / European HCI

### Not Recommended For

- Pure US ACM SIGCHI work (consider TOCHI)
- Pure HCI engineering (consider IEEE)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Human-Computer Interaction (T&F)](../hci/human-computer-interaction.md) | T&F HCI flagship |
| 2 | [International Journal of Human-Computer Studies](../hci/international-journal-of-human-computer-studies.md) | Elsevier cognitive-HCI |
| 3 | [ACM Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction](../hci/acm-transactions-on-computer-human-interaction.md) | ACM SIGCHI |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from TOCHI as "too UK / design-centric," IwC is the OUP BCS-affiliated home.
